strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 10 turns
So you've come... Later than I expected.
...Char! Why drop Axis on Earth...!
If you do that... Earth will freeze over and no one will be able to live there!
Why!? Captain Quattro!
Why... Was that battle all for nothing!?
A man who fought alongside us... Why is he trying to crush Earth!?
Those who remain on Earth do nothing but pollute it.
They are people whose souls are bound by gravity.
That's just what you've convinced yourself!
...But... for those of us born in the colonies...
it's not that I can't understand...
Hey, Roux!?
...After that... what the Earth Federation did,
don't tell me you've forgotten.
W-Well, that's...
Nothing changed. ...It was the same as before.
...Yes. The Titans, Neo Zeon, the invaders from other worlds...
and those who, from ancient times on Earth, the land of the beginning,
watched over the universe's fate... we defeated them all... And yet...
Earth... hasn't changed at all... Not its thinking... nor its system.
But... but!
That's why we have to be the ones to change it...!
...So this is Quattro's... no, Char Aznable's answer.
That's right, Banjo Haran.
Those who live on Earth think only of themselves!
That is why I declared I would wipe them out!
What the heck! This is no different from the Gaizok!
No... It's different.
...Huh?
...The Captain is thinking beyond this...!
I get it... but... doing it this way...! Captain!
For man to pass judgment on man...!
I, Char Aznable, intend to purge them...! Amuro!
That's nothing but ego!
The time has come when Earth can no longer endure!
Hey, Show! If that thing falls... what'll happen to Byston Well!?
...I don't know.
But even if Byston Well is safe...
that's something that must never be done...!
...Someone must shoulder the sins of humanity.
Why shoulder it alone, and in such a way!?
I only wish to restore Earth as it was, and await humanity's innovation!
Can't you wait!? The invaders and the Einst are all gone...!
...Because they're gone. That's exactly why we must do it...!
But...!
Give it up, Ryo. ...We've got no choice but to fight.
...We know better than anyone what kind of man he is.
Yeah. ...That fella's dead serious.
To go this far, his resolve ain't no half-measure.
...We'll stop him. There's gotta be another way.
Colonel... are you sure about this?
...Nanai, launch the mobile suits!
Good luck to you all!
Ten more minutes...! Once Axis is on course, no one can stop it...!
Captain Bright, ten minutes left. If we can't stop Axis by then...
nothing we do will be able to keep it from falling to Earth...
...Understood. All hands, you heard that transmission!?
Ten minutes left!
Once Axis is on its descent orbit and the nuclear pulse engines ignite...
we won't be able to stop it from falling to Earth...!
Tch, we gotta finish a fight for Earth's fate in ten minutes?
It's easier on the mind to think we've got that much time.
No kidding... I just hate who we're up against, though.
Shiro... Must you really... fight that man?
After overcoming those hard battles... together? Why...?
...We have no choice.
If this is the answer he's reached... then our answer is to stop it.
Axis... go...! Along with all those cursed memories...!
Tch! I can't die... in a place like this!
The Gundam! I just gotta take him out, right!?
Whoa, whoa! A whole bunch of 'em just showed up!
Geez! There's no end to them!
I feel a pressure... like Ple's...?
Heh... I won't let you get the Colonel!
Human innovation... What it needs... is young blood.
The man who said the old don't create a new era...!
is using children...!
Kinda mixed feelings here...!
Hmph, who cares about age!
What matters is if you've thought about why you're fighting, right!?
...Which side... is right, Kyosuke? I...
...I'd like to believe... neither is wrong.
Anyway... that's Captain Quattro for you... He came fully prepared.
Tch! I won't lose a battle of endurance!
That's right! Overcoming adversity is what makes a hero!
That voice...
Sorry to keep ya waitin', everyone! With me here, it's like a thousand men!
Yamada, please don't get carried away and stray too far again.
Enter the Nadesico!
Captain Misumaru... B-But didn't your crew disband?
Well, if Earth becomes uninhabitable, business is out of the question...
and space is already Anaheim's turf.
It's not that I don't get how Captain Quattro feels...
but I feel like we shouldn't be the ones to crush Earth.
I believe in Akito! And in my own will too...!
Tch...
All units! Check the range of the Nadesico's Gravity Wave Beam!
Separate them from the Nadesico and the Aestivalis can't move...
Surround them and cut them off.
Not so fast!
What!?
Goooood! Fingerrrrr!!
Could this be...
Hey! You guys hitched a ride on the Nadesico! No fair!
Hmph... There's no fair or unfair in a fight.
Sorry, everyone! We got the message, but
finding Domon and Allenby took us a while.
I was looking for Master to learn Meikyo Shisui,
and got separated from Rain... Sorry.
I'm a bit late... But allow me to help as much as I can!
No... You made it in time. We're grateful.
Hah, I had foreseen that this would happen.
It is hardly my place to say so...
No... Precisely because I made the same mistake!
I shall put a stop to your rampage!
All right! Aestivalis squad! Let's go all out!
Yeah!
We'll stop Axis...
Colonel... this is...
"Earthlings protect the Earth," is it...
Why can't they see that this only spoils those on the ground...!
Why, you!?
Damn it, Captain Quattro...! Why!
If you go any further... there's no turning back!
...If that's the path he chose, so be it... But we can't let him do it...!
We just have to prove it, right!? Yurika! Let's goooo!!
Okay! Akito!
All forces, commence attack!
You got Gyunei!?
Shot down!?
...It's all right. We're recovering Quess's escape pod.
Heh... It's time...
What!?
Can't we stop it!?
It can't... be stopped now... The operation has failed.
Are you saying... Char has won!?
...This power... is fine while it works toward what's right, but...
Don'tcha get it!? Now's that time!!
Don't get cocky!
Now is our chance...
Captain Bright, let's land on Axis and destroy it from within.
So it seems... All units! Surround Axis!
